leads.title: Equal Opportunities Act 2006
leads.documents: Prohibits discrimination in employment and provision of goods/services on grounds including sexual orientation and 'gender reassignment'; defines gender reassignment as process for reassigning sex by changing physiological or other attributes.
leads.detail: Came into force 1 March 2007; cited in Discrimination protections section

leads.title: Crimes Act 2011 (Gibraltar)
leads.documents: Gender-neutral criminal law setting equal age of consent at 16 regardless of sexual orientation; decriminalised heterosexual anal sex; reflects Supreme Court decision.
leads.detail: Approved August 2011, took effect 23 November 2012; cited as gender-neutral Crimes Act 2011

leads.title: Crimes Act 2011 Amendment - Hate Crime 2013
leads.documents: Criminalises hatred and harassment on ground of sexual orientation as hate crime - enforcement machinery for anti-LGBTQ acts.
leads.detail: Approved by Gibraltar Parliament 19 September 2013, royal assent 25 September, took effect 10 October 2013

leads.title: Parliament bill July 2026 - hate crime protections for 'transgender identity'
leads.documents: Amends hate crime and hate speech legislation to explicitly include protections for transgender identity - directly relevant to trans-visitor safety.
leads.detail: Passed July 2026 per Hate crime legislation section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Parliament bill July 2026 - conversion therapy ban
leads.documents: Makes it an offence to offer or practice conversion therapy - relevant to trans rights protection.
leads.detail: Passed July 2026 per Conversion therapy section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Civil Marriage Amendment Act 2016
leads.documents: Legalises same-sex marriage in Gibraltar; includes provision requiring alternative registrar if deputy registrar opts out.
leads.detail: Passed 26 October 2016 unanimously, royal assent 1 November, took effect 15 December 2016; first marriage next day

leads.title: Civil Partnership Law March 2014
leads.documents: Created civil partnerships for same-sex and opposite-sex couples granting most rights of marriage including adoption by civil partners as mandated by 2013 court ruling.
leads.detail: Passed March 2014 per Recognition of same-sex relationships section

leads.title: Supreme Court of Gibraltar - Adoption ruling 10 April 2013
leads.documents: Ruled section 5(2) Adoption Act 1951 violated Gibraltar Constitution, de jure legalising LGBT adoption; government then amended law.
leads.detail: Decided 10 April 2013; followed by Adoption Act 2023 effective 18 April 2024 explicitly allowing same-sex adoption

leads.title: Supreme Court of Gibraltar - Age of consent ruling 8 April 2011
leads.documents: Ruled higher age of consent of 18 for gay sex unconstitutional, mandated equal age 16 and decriminalised heterosexual anal sex.
leads.detail: Decided 8 April 2011; sought March 2010 via constitutional test mechanism; noted Foreign Secretary David Miliband 1 April 2010 warning of Order in Council

leads.title: Gibraltar Constitution 2006
leads.documents: Constitutional rights framework; noted as NOT mentioning sexual orientation after 2002 proposals omitted it as protected category.
leads.detail: 2006 Constitution; proposals made public early March 2002 omitted sexual orientation
